text:
tara: heads-up canary v3.1.0 at 40% in eu-west showing p95 spike ~900ms, started 6m ago :warning:
deploy-bot: rollout: v3.1.0 -> 40% eu-west. metrics snapshot: p95=905ms (baseline 380ms), errors=0.2%
leo: looks cluster-wide across 3 pods, not just a noisy host
sylvie: any recent kernel/quant flags? I don't see infra diffs in PR
deploy-bot: autopilot: autorevert rule p95>750ms sustained 5m. breach detected 3m ago. auto-revert scheduled in ~2m unless held
pm-ana: if auto-reverts we need a release-note blurb. prefer manual triage first
ops-ram: agree—pin traffic at 40% and run focused restarts on worst pods. low customer impact so manual hold preferred
tara: pinned by me. hold applied. deploy-bot: autopilot suppressed by manual hold
leo: restarting pod-12 and pod-15 now, will watch p95 per-pod
sylvie: checking model kernel logs, seeing kernel selection flips at token ~256 boundary on those pods
ops-ram: if kernel flip, rollback likely cleaner than hotfix. recommended rollback target v3.0.8 (build 20260318.9) if restarts don't help
sylvie: restart reports: pod-15 p95 fell to 420ms, pod-12 to 450ms. cluster p95 now 470ms
tara: good recovery. keep hold for 12m. if it climbs above 650ms sustained 5m we execute rollback to v3.0.8
pm-ana: customer note queued: "Canary paused for v3.1.0 due to increased latency in a subset of requests. We're investigating; no customer errors observed." send on approval
ops-ram: approve send, tagging support. logging incident tag: canary-latency-kernel-swap
tara: thanks team, will update thread after monitoring interval :hourglass:
